content:
As the 2026 World Cup draws to a close, Major League Soccer (MLS) will return to Apple TV tomorrow, with related features also launching simultaneously on Apple Maps, Apple Sports, Apple Fitness+, and other platforms. Details are as follows:

MLS Returns to Apple TV

Apple is highlighting the return of 'Apple League Soccer' today, with six matches scheduled over the next few days:

July 16 (Thursday):

  • CF Montréal vs Toronto FC (7:30 PM ET)
  • Chicago Fire vs Vancouver Whitecaps (8:30 PM ET)
  • St. Louis City SC vs Sporting Kansas City (8:30 PM ET)
  • Seattle Sounders vs Portland Timbers (10:30 PM ET)

July 17 (Friday):

  • Nashville SC vs Atlanta United FC (8:10 PM ET)
  • LA Galaxy vs LAFC (10:15 PM ET)

To celebrate the return of the regular season, Apple has announced a series of MLS-themed features across its platforms, including a new 'Time to Walk' audio experience for Apple Fitness+ subscribers.

The latest episode is hosted by German football legend Thomas Müller, who 'reflects on the efforts made before fame and shares why he embraces the challenge of major life changes'.

Apple Music will also launch exclusive playlists curated by the players themselves, including Diego Luna of Real Salt Lake and Evander da Silva Ferreira of FC Cincinnati. Themed playlists for Eastern and Western Conference clubs such as the New York Red Bulls, New York City FC, and Orlando City SC will also be available.

On Apple Maps, Apple will introduce 'matchday guides produced by MLS clubs and city tour routes personally recommended by players, helping users discover local restaurants, attractions, and detailed stadium information'.

Fans using the Apple Sports app can stay up to date with the latest league information, including live scores, standings, match updates, lineups, and team statistics.

Finally, Apple stated:

MLS matches are available for free to Apple TV subscribers in over 100 countries and regions worldwide. Apple will also provide exclusive content and access to all cup competitions and playoffs throughout the season.

To learn more about Apple's coverage of the MLS return, please click here.

Apple TV costs US$12.99 per month and can also be subscribed to via the Apple One bundle. The platform offers a wide range of popular series and films, including 'Severance', 'The Studio', 'The Morning Show', 'Busy Town', and 'Silo'.
